title.zh: 免疫問題與傳染病（兒科）

overview.en: Pediatric HIV/AIDS (diagnosis, prophylaxis, immunization, home care) and common childhood communicable diseases: measles, roseola, rubella, mumps, varicella, pertussis, diphtheria, polio, scarlet fever, fifth disease, mononucleosis, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, CA-MRSA, influenza and COVID-19, with isolation precautions.
overview.zh: 兒童HIV/AIDS（診斷、預防性用藥、疫苗、居家照護）與常見兒童傳染病：麻疹、玫瑰疹、德國麻疹、腮腺炎、水痘、百日咳、白喉、小兒麻痺、猩紅熱、第五病、傳染性單核球增多症、落磯山斑疹熱、社區型MRSA、流感與COVID-19，以及隔離措施。

points.en: Standard precautions for all children; add airborne, droplet or contact precautions by disease (e.g., influenza plus wound infection needs both).
points.zh: 所有兒童採標準防護；依疾病加上空氣、飛沫或接觸防護（如流感併傷口感染則需多重）。

points.en: HIV infects CD4+ T cells, causing progressive immunodeficiency and opportunistic infections.
points.zh: HIV感染CD4+ T細胞，造成進行性免疫缺損與伺機性感染。

points.en: Spread by blood, semen, vaginal secretions and human milk; vertical (perinatal) or horizontal (sexual, parenteral).
points.zh: 經血液、精液、陰道分泌物與母乳傳播；垂直（周產期）或水平（性接觸、血液）。

points.en: Most common opportunistic infection in children: Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia, often at 3-6 months; cough is a common sign.
points.zh: 兒童最常見的伺機性感染：肺囊蟲肺炎（P. jiroveci），常見於3-6個月；咳嗽為常見徵象。

points.en: Findings: failure to thrive, chronic diarrhea/cough, oral candidiasis, lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly, parotitis, developmental delay or regression.
points.zh: 表現：生長遲滯、慢性腹瀉/咳嗽、口腔念珠菌感染、淋巴結腫大、肝脾腫大、腮腺炎、發展遲緩或退化。

points.en: Under 18 months: use PCR (proviral DNA) or p24 antigen, accurate at 1-4 months; ELISA/Western blot only from 18 months because maternal antibodies cross the placenta.
points.zh: 18個月以下：用PCR（前病毒DNA）或p24抗原，1-4個月最準；ELISA/Western blot需18個月後才用，因母體抗體會經胎盤傳給嬰兒。

points.en: CD4+ counts are age-adjusted; severe suppression <15% or <750/uL (<12 mo), <500 (1-5 y), <200 (6-12 y).
Goals: slow viral replication with combination antiretrovirals, prevent/treat opportunistic infections, nutrition, symptom control; PJP prophylaxis especially in first year of life.
points.zh: 目標：以複合抗反轉錄病毒藥物減緩病毒複製、預防/治療伺機性感染、營養、症狀控制；尤其出生第一年給予PJP預防。

points.en: Immunize all HIV-exposed/infected children; if symptomatic or severely immunosuppressed use only inactivated vaccines (IM influenza yearly, inactivated polio); no measles, varicella or rotavirus vaccine; give VZIG after varicella exposure and immunoglobulin after measles exposure.
points.zh: 所有HIV暴露/感染兒童皆應接種疫苗；有症狀或重度免疫抑制時僅用不活化疫苗（每年IM流感、不活化小兒麻痺）；不給麻疹、水痘、輪狀病毒疫苗；水痘暴露後給VZIG，麻疹暴露後給免疫球蛋白。

heading.en: HIV home care and adolescent education
heading.zh: HIV居家照護與青少年衛教

points.en: Frequent handwashing, gloves with body fluids, avoid contagious contacts, keep child home when sick, keep immunizations current.
points.zh: 勤洗手、接觸體液戴手套、避免接觸傳染性病人、生病在家休養、疫苗按時接種。

points.en: Report fever, malaise, weight loss, vomiting, diarrhea, oral lesions; monitor weight; high-calorie, high-protein diet; no raw meat/fish or unwashed produce if immunosuppressed.
points.zh: 發燒、倦怠、體重減輕、嘔吐、腹瀉、口腔病灶需通報；監測體重；高熱量高蛋白飲食；免疫低下時避免生肉/魚與未洗蔬果。

points.en: Dishwasher for utensils; discard unused food/formula after 24 h; fold soiled diapers inward into covered bin; clean spills with bleach 1:10 (bleach:water as 10 water to 1 bleach).
points.zh: 餐具用洗碗機清洗；未食用食物/配方奶24小時後丟棄；髒尿布向內摺並放入有蓋垃圾桶；體液外溢以漂白水（水:漂白水=10:1）清理。

points.en: Adolescents: teach transmission, abstinence, condoms, risk reduction and support resources.
points.zh: 青少年：教導傳染途徑、禁慾、保險套、降低風險與支持資源。

heading.zh: 麻疹、玫瑰疹、德國麻疹、腮腺炎

points.en: Measles (rubeola): the 3 Cs (coryza, cough, conjunctivitis), Koplik spots (blue-white spots with red base on buccal mucosa), rash from face downward; airborne + contact precautions, rest, cool mist, dim lights, vitamin A.
points.zh: 麻疹：3C（鼻炎、咳嗽、結膜炎）、Koplik斑（頰黏膜藍白點、紅底）、紅疹由臉向下蔓延；空氣+接觸防護、休息、冷霧、調暗燈光、補充維生素A。

points.en: Roseola (HHV-6): high fever 3-5 days in a well-looking child, then rose-pink rash after fever breaks; febrile seizures possible; supportive care.
points.zh: 玫瑰疹（HHV-6）：外觀良好的孩子高燒3-5天，退燒後出現玫瑰色疹；可能熱痙攣；支持性照護。

points.en: Rubella: low fever, face-to-body pink maculopapular rash in 1-3 days, soft palate petechiae; airborne/droplet/contact precautions; keep away from pregnant persons.
points.zh: 德國麻疹：低燒、1-3天內由臉蔓延全身的粉紅斑丘疹、軟顎瘀點；空氣/飛沫/接觸防護；遠離孕婦。

points.en: Mumps: parotid swelling, jaw/ear pain with chewing, orchitis, deafness, aseptic meningitis; droplet + contact precautions, soft foods, rest, scrotal support; lethargy/vomiting means evaluate for meningitis.
points.zh: 腮腺炎：腮腺腫脹、咀嚼時下顎/耳痛、睪丸炎、耳聾、無菌性腦膜炎；飛沫+接觸防護、軟食、休息、陰囊托高；嗜睡/嘔吐需評估腦膜炎。

heading.zh: 水痘、百日咳、白喉、小兒麻痺

points.en: Varicella: macules to vesicles to crusts, trunk and scalp first; contagious 1-2 days before rash until all crusted (about 6 days); airborne, droplet and contact precautions; VZIG/IVIG for high-risk exposed children.
points.zh: 水痘：斑疹→水泡→結痂，先出現於軀幹與頭皮；出疹前1-2天至全部結痂（約6天）具傳染力；空氣、飛沫與接觸防護；高風險暴露兒童給VZIG/IVIG。

points.en: Pertussis: cough with loud whoop, cyanosis, tongue protrusion; droplet + contact precautions, antibiotics, avoid cough triggers, hydration, suction/oxygen; contagious in catarrhal stage; infants lack maternal immunity, so Tdap for postpartum parent and close contacts.
points.zh: 百日咳：咳嗽伴吸氣哮鳴、發紺、吐舌；飛沫+接觸防護、抗生素、避免誘發咳嗽因素、補水、吸痰/氧氣；卡他期傳染力最強；嬰兒無母體免疫，產後父母與密切接觸者接種Tdap。

points.en: Diphtheria: sore throat, foul nasal discharge, dense pseudomembrane, bull neck; strict isolation, antitoxin after horse-serum sensitivity test, antibiotics, suction, trach care.
points.zh: 白喉：喉嚨痛、惡臭鼻分泌物、厚偽膜、牛頸；嚴格隔離、先做馬血清過敏測試再給抗毒素、抗生素、吸痰、氣切護理。

points.en: Polio: enterovirus, fecal-oral; fever, stiffness, possible paralysis; enteric and contact precautions, watch respiratory paralysis, PT.
points.zh: 小兒麻痺：腸病毒、糞口傳染；發燒、僵硬、可能麻痺；腸道與接觸防護、注意呼吸麻痺、物理治療。

heading.en: Scarlet fever, fifth disease, mononucleosis, RMSF
heading.zh: 猩紅熱、第五病、單核球增多症、落磯山斑疹熱

points.en: Scarlet fever (group A strep): sandpaper rash sparing face, Pastia lines, strawberry tongue, desquamation of palms/soles; contact + droplet precautions until 24 h of antibiotics.
points.zh: 猩紅熱（A群鏈球菌）：砂紙樣疹、臉部不受影響、Pastia線、草莓舌、掌蹠脫皮；接觸+飛沫防護至抗生素24小時後。

points.en: Fifth disease (parvovirus B19): slapped-cheek rash then lacy rash on extremities; supportive; pregnant contacts should call their provider.
points.zh: 第五病（微小病毒B19）：拍打臉頰樣紅斑，之後四肢網狀疹；支持性照護；孕婦接觸者應通知醫師。

points.en: Mononucleosis (EBV): fever, sore throat, lymphadenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly; teach splenic rupture signs (LUQ/left shoulder pain, abdominal pain).
points.zh: 傳染性單核球增多症（EBV）：發燒、喉痛、淋巴結腫、肝脾腫大；教導脾破裂徵象（左上腹/左肩/腹痛）。

points.en: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (tick-borne Rickettsia): fever, headache, rash on wrists/ankles spreading to palms/soles; antibiotics; prevention box on tick bites.
points.zh: 落磯山斑疹熱（蜱傳立克次體）：發燒、頭痛、手腕腳踝紅疹並擴及掌蹠；抗生素；蜱咬預防。

points.en: Tick removal: tweezers at skin, pull straight up steadily, save tick, wash hands; wear light long clothing, DEET/permethrin with caution.
points.zh: 移除蜱：鑷子貼近皮膚、穩定向上直拉、保留蜱、洗手；穿淺色長袖長褲、謹慎使用DEET/permethrin。

points.en: CA-MRSA: infection in a healthy person without recent health-care exposure; spread by contact and contaminated items; red, warm, painful, pus-draining skin lesion; can progress to sepsis.
points.zh: CA-MRSA：無近期醫療接觸的健康者感染；經接觸與污染物品傳播；皮膚紅腫熱痛流膿；可進展為敗血症。

points.en: Prevention: handwashing, no sharing personal items, clean shared equipment, cover wounds; care: assess, drainage and cultures, antibiotics.
points.zh: 預防：洗手、不共用個人物品、清潔共用器材、覆蓋傷口；處置：評估、引流與培養、抗生素。

points.en: Influenza: sudden high fever, aches, cough; annual vaccine, hand hygiene, keep home until fever-free 24 h without antipyretics; antivirals, fluids, rest.
points.zh: 流感：突發高燒、痠痛、咳嗽；每年疫苗、手部衛生、無退燒藥下退燒24小時後才返校；抗病毒藥、補水、休息。

points.en: COVID-19: droplet/airborne + contact precautions; fever and cough common; seek care for breathing difficulty, cyanosis, confusion, inability to keep fluids; watch for pediatric inflammatory multisystem syndrome (Kawasaki-like).
points.zh: COVID-19：飛沫/空氣+接觸防護；常見發燒咳嗽；呼吸困難、發紺、意識混亂、無法進水需就醫；注意兒童多系統發炎症候群（類川崎病）。

points.en: Immunization schedules follow Chapter 19 and CDC guidance.
points.zh: 疫苗時程參照第19章與CDC指引。

critical_points.en: P. jiroveci pneumonia is the most common opportunistic infection in HIV-infected children (peak 3-6 months); cough is a key sign.
critical_points.zh: 肺囊蟲肺炎為HIV感染兒童最常見伺機性感染（高峰3-6個月）；咳嗽為關鍵徵象。

critical_points.en: Infants <18 months: PCR or p24 antigen, not ELISA (maternal antibodies cross placenta).
critical_points.zh: 18個月以下嬰兒：使用PCR或p24抗原，而非ELISA（母體抗體經胎盤）。

critical_points.en: Symptomatic/immunosuppressed HIV child: no live vaccines (measles, varicella, rotavirus); IM inactivated influenza yearly.
critical_points.zh: 有症狀/免疫抑制之HIV兒童：不給活性疫苗（麻疹、水痘、輪狀病毒）；每年IM不活化流感疫苗。

critical_points.en: HIV-infected child with fever must stay home; clean body fluid spills with bleach (alcohol ineffective).
critical_points.zh: HIV感染兒童發燒須留在家中；體液外溢用漂白水清理（酒精無效）。

critical_points.en: Measles: Koplik spots, 3 Cs, airborne + contact precautions, vitamin A.
critical_points.zh: 麻疹：Koplik斑、3C、空氣+接觸防護、維生素A。

critical_points.en: Roseola: high fever first, rash appears after fever resolves.
critical_points.zh: 玫瑰疹：先高燒，退燒後才出疹。
德國麻疹：需與孕婦隔離。

critical_points.en: Mumps with lethargy or vomiting: suspect aseptic meningitis, child needs to be seen; orchitis supported with snug underwear.
critical_points.zh: 腮腺炎合併嗜睡或嘔吐：懷疑無菌性腦膜炎，需就診；睪丸炎以合身內褲托高。

critical_points.en: Varicella: airborne, droplet and contact precautions; contagious until all lesions crusted; VZIG for susceptible immunocompromised exposures.
critical_points.zh: 水痘：空氣、飛沫、接觸防護；全部結痂前具傳染力；易感免疫低下者暴露後給VZIG。

critical_points.en: Pertussis: droplet precautions during catarrhal stage; no isolation needed in convalescence; Tdap for caregivers.
critical_points.zh: 百日咳：卡他期飛沫防護；恢復期不需隔離；照顧者接種Tdap。

critical_points.en: Diphtheria antitoxin requires horse-serum sensitivity testing first; pseudomembrane threatens airway.
critical_points.zh: 白喉抗毒素需先做馬血清過敏測試；偽膜威脅呼吸道。

critical_points.en: Scarlet fever: sandpaper rash, strawberry tongue, Pastia lines; precautions until 24 h of antibiotics.
critical_points.zh: 猩紅熱：砂紙疹、草莓舌、Pastia線；抗生素24小時內仍需防護。

critical_points.en: Fifth disease: slapped-cheek rash; pregnant contacts notify provider.
critical_points.zh: 第五病：拍臉頰疹；孕婦接觸者通知醫師。

critical_points.en: Mononucleosis: avoid contact sports; report LUQ or left-shoulder pain (splenic rupture).
critical_points.zh: 單核球增多症：避免接觸性運動；左上腹或左肩痛需通報（脾破裂）。

critical_points.en: RMSF: rash on wrists/ankles and palms/soles after tick bite; remove tick with tweezers straight up.
critical_points.zh: 落磯山斑疹熱：蜱咬後手腕腳踝及掌蹠出疹；用鑷子垂直向上移除蜱。

critical_points.en: Influenza: return to school after 24 h fever-free without antipyretics.
critical_points.zh: 流感：無退燒藥下退燒24小時後才可返校。

mnemonics.en: Measles '3 Cs + K': Coryza, Cough, Conjunctivitis, Koplik spots.
mnemonics.zh: 麻疹「3C+K」：鼻炎、咳嗽、結膜炎、Koplik斑。

mnemonics.en: Rash direction: measles and rubella start on the face and go down; scarlet fever spares the face; RMSF starts on wrists/ankles.
mnemonics.zh: 疹子方向：麻疹與德國麻疹由臉往下；猩紅熱臉部不受影響；RMSF由手腕腳踝開始。

mnemonics.en: Roseola: 'Rash Only after Fever' (rose rash after fever ends).

stem.en: An infant of an HIV-positive parent is monitored. Which sign suggests the most common opportunistic infection?
stem.zh: HIV陽性父母的嬰兒接受監測。哪項徵象提示最常見的伺機性感染？

rationale.en: Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia is most common, around 3-6 months, and presents with cough and respiratory signs.
rationale.zh: 肺囊蟲肺炎最常見，約3-6個月，表現為咳嗽與呼吸症狀。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which test is most appropriate to diagnose HIV in a 2-month-old born to an HIV-positive parent?
stem.zh: HIV陽性父母所生2個月嬰兒，最適合哪項診斷檢查？

rationale.en: Maternal antibodies make antibody tests unreliable before 18 months; PCR or p24 antigen is accurate in infants.
rationale.zh: 母體抗體使18個月前抗體檢測不可靠；PCR或p24抗原適用於嬰兒。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statements by a parent of a child with HIV show understanding? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: HIV兒童家長哪些說法顯示理解？（複選）

options.en: "I'll clean diaper spills with a bleach solution."
"He will get the yearly inactivated flu shot."
options.zh: 「他每年會打不活化流感疫苗。」

options.en: "A low-grade fever is fine for day care."
"I'll wash his dishes in the dishwasher."

options.zh: 「我會提供高熱量高蛋白食物。」

rationale.en: A sick or febrile child stays home; other statements are correct.
rationale.zh: 生病或發燒的孩子應留在家；其餘皆正確。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: The nurse finds small blue-white spots with a red base on the buccal mucosa of a febrile child. Which precautions are required?
stem.zh: 護理師發現發燒孩童頰黏膜有紅底藍白小點。需何種防護？

rationale.en: Koplik spots indicate measles, which requires airborne plus contact precautions.
rationale.zh: Koplik斑代表麻疹，需空氣加接觸防護。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A toddler had 4 days of high fever; the fever stopped and a pink rash appeared on the trunk. The child looks well. Which condition is likely?
stem.zh: 幼兒高燒4天，退燒後軀幹出現粉紅疹，外觀良好。最可能為何？

rationale.en: Roseola (HHV-6) features high fever then rash after defervescence.
rationale.zh: 玫瑰疹（HHV-6）為先高燒，退燒後出疹。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A parent calls: a child with mumps is lethargic and vomiting. What should the nurse advise?
stem.zh: 腮腺炎孩童家長來電：孩子嗜睡且嘔吐。護理師應建議？

options.en: Bring the child to be evaluated

rationale.en: Lethargy and vomiting may signal aseptic meningitis, a complication of mumps.
rationale.zh: 嗜睡與嘔吐可能為腮腺炎併發的無菌性腦膜炎。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A child with infectious mononucleosis should be taught to report which finding immediately?
stem.zh: 傳染性單核球增多症孩童應被教導立即通報何者？

options.en: Left upper quadrant and left shoulder pain

rationale.en: These suggest splenic rupture, an emergency.
rationale.zh: 提示脾破裂，屬緊急狀況。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which are correct tick-bite prevention and removal measures? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些為正確的蜱咬預防與移除措施？（複選）

options.en: Grasp the tick near the skin and pull straight up
options.zh: 夾住貼近皮膚處並垂直拔起

options.en: Burn the tick with a match
Stay on paths rather than tall grass

rationale.en: Burning or smothering ticks is not recommended; use tweezers.
rationale.zh: 不建議燒或悶蜱；應使用鑷子。
